title: President Biden on Nord Stream 2 Pipeline if Russia Invades Ukraine: "We will bring an end to it."
summary: A C-SPAN clip from a joint press conference with Olaf Scholz in which President Biden says that if Russia invades Ukraine, there will no longer be a Nord Stream 2. Pressed on how, he promises it can be done.
why: Repeatedly cited in Nord Stream sabotage threads as evidence of stated US intent toward the pipeline.
